0022600109.text: The San Antonio Spurs (0-2, 12th in the West) visit the Dallas Mavericks (1-1, 9th in the West) for their third game of the 2026-27 season, looking to snap a two-game losing streak. Jayden Quaintance is out for San Antonio after knee surgery, and Tobias Harris is day-to-day with a calf strain and a game-time decision. Dallas is without Cooper Flagg (shoulder soreness) and Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), while Caleb Martin, Jett Howard, Santi Aldama and Tarik Biberovic are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not played each other yet this season, but the Spurs won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season series and beat the Mavericks 139-120 in San Antonio on April 10, 2026.
